stock.description: San Miguel Brewery Hong Kong Limited (SMBHK) engages in the production and distribution of various beer formats, including bottled, canned, and draught, across Hong Kong, mainland China, the Philippines, and other international markets. The company's product lineup features well-known brands such as San Miguel Pale Pilsen, San Mig Light, San Miguel Cerveza Negra, and San Miguel Cerveza Blanca. Founded in 1948, SMBHK maintains its primary operational base in Shatin, Hong Kong, and functions as a subsidiary of Neptunia Corporation Limited.
